title: Eagle Valentina Arch Bed – Double Arch Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Valentina Double Arch Bed is for anyone who prefers soft curves to hard angles. Its double arch headboard gives the bed a lower, more relaxed profile, which works well in smaller rooms where a tall statement headboard would feel like too much. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Double arch curved headboard
  • Low-profile, fully upholstered frame
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £419.99; Small Double (4FT) £389.99; Double (4FT6) £409.99; King (5FT) £439.99; Super King (6FT) £469.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Teddy Bouclé, in a wide colour choice. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is the Valentina a good choice for a smaller room?

Its low-profile double arch headboard has a more relaxed profile than a tall statement headboard, so it suits smaller rooms well. See our best beds for small bedrooms for more ideas.

Can I get ottoman storage?

Yes. Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
